sentences.en: When you travel, you've got to try the local brew.
sentences.zh: 旅行的时候一定要尝尝当地的特色饮品。

sentences.en: This beer is brewed according to the Bavarian Purity Law.
sentences.zh: 这啤酒是按照巴伐利亚纯净法酿造的。

sentences.en: She had the distinct feeling that something was brewing.
sentences.zh: 她觉得有什么事情正在酝酿中。
